description: This file is an HTML document that serves as the frontend interface for a database visualizer web application. It includes HTML structure, CSS styling, and JavaScript code to load and display database lists, tables, and data, with interactive features like refresh, expand, and clickable elements.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the server.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching data from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data from a selected table, limited to 50 records.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML for displaying data in tabular form.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual table cell content, handling objects, nulls, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data on click.
